title: Chicken and sweet potato traybake with broccoli
steps: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Dice the sweet potato and cut the onion into wedges, toss with half the oil, paprika and salt and bake for 15 minutes.
Cut the chicken into large pieces and mix with the remaining oil, garlic, thyme, salt and pepper.
Add the chicken and broccoli florets to the tray and bake for 15–18 minutes more until the chicken is cooked.
Stir the yoghurt with lemon juice and salt and serve alongside.
